hero.title: Industrial Salt
hero.intro: Beyond the retail shelf, Ankur Salt supplies industrial grade salt to manufacturers who need consistent purity and controlled hardness, batch after batch, from Free Flow through our finest Low Hardness grades.

grades.heading: Grades and Specifications
grades.subheading: Every grade is tested against the same specification, every batch.

items.name: FMCG
items.useCase: Used across food processing, personal care, and household product manufacturing where consistent purity and solubility matter.

items.name: Textiles and Dyes
items.useCase: Fixes dyes and stabilises colour output during fabric dyeing, printing, and finishing.

items.name: Water Treatment
items.useCase: Regenerates ion exchange resins in softening plants and effluent treatment.

items.name: Petroleum Additives
items.useCase: Used as a base input in drilling fluid and petroleum additive formulations.

items.name: Chemicals and Intermediates
items.useCase: A key raw material in chlor-alkali and other chemical manufacturing processes, including caustic soda, chlorine, and soda ash production.

items.name: Pharmaceuticals
items.useCase: Meets the high purity, low hardness requirements of pharmaceutical grade formulations.
